'''Proton-scattering energy warheads''' were a specific type of [[Warhead/Legends|warhead]] utilized by [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]].<ref name="SWS" /> The high-yield warheads were among the most powerful weapons that could be carried by [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
